frase_gancho.texto: A city raised on hills, with a stone road that still enters by the same place.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You begin at the entrance to the archaeological zone of Xochicalco, in Morelos. This city arose in the Epiclassic, when the great centers of the previous period fell. Before you climb, it helps to understand what kind of city this is and why it was built where it stands.
